heroTitle: Planning for retirement, through retirement, and the years leading up to it.
heroSub: The questions change depending on where you are. Someone ten years from retirement has different decisions to make than someone who's already there. We help you understand where you are today and make a plan for what comes next.

groups.title: In Retirement
groups.body:
You've spent years building your savings. Once you're retired, the decisions become more focused on how to use what you've built.

We help you think through how much you can spend, where your income should come from, how your investments should support that income, and how taxes and protection fit into the picture.

We also continue adjusting the plan as your spending, health, family, or priorities change.
groups.listIntro: What we may work through includes:
items: How much income the plan can reasonably support
Social Security, pensions, and investment withdrawals
Investment risk and how the portfolio supports spending
Long-term care and other protection needs
What you want to leave to family or other people and causes you care about

groups.title: Approaching Retirement
groups.body:
The years leading up to retirement give you time to make decisions while you still have options.

We look at when you want to retire, what you are currently saving, what retirement may cost, when Social Security may make sense, how your 401(k) and other accounts fit together, and how much investment risk is appropriate as retirement gets closer.

The goal is to understand what your current path looks like and where adjustments may be worth considering before the paycheck stops.
groups.listIntro: What we may work through includes:
items: Your retirement timeline and what it may take to get there
Cash needs around the retirement transition
Insurance and protection while you still have time to make changes

groups.title: Still Building
groups.body:
Some clients come to us earlier in their working years.

At that stage, the work is more focused on whether saving, investing, cash flow, and protection are moving you toward the future you want.

Starting earlier can give us more time to make adjustments and more options as retirement gets closer.
groups.listIntro: What we may work through includes:
items: Building toward the income you may want later

notFitHeading: A good fit for One Life
notFitBody:
We tend to work best with people who have been thoughtful with their money and now want a clearer plan for what comes next.

They value planning, want the different pieces of their financial life coordinated, and want an ongoing relationship with an advisor who understands their situation.

If that sounds like what you're looking for, the Clarity Call is a simple way to see whether working together makes sense.
closingHeading: Want to see if we're a fit?
closingSub: A Clarity Call is a 15 to 30 minute conversation about where you are, what you're trying to accomplish, and whether the work we do fits what you're looking for.
